### ⚠️ Requires [Provi's Origins](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki) to be installed! ⚠️

## Occlude Vibrations

---

[Power Type](https://github.com/Provismet/Provi-Origins/wiki/Power-Types)

Prevents the entity from being *accepted* as a vibration source. In most cases this effectively prevents any vibrations from being detected from the entity's actions. The vibrations still exist, they are simply ignored or lack an owner.

Type ID: `proviorigins:occlude_vibrations`

| Note |
| :--- |
| Stepping directly on a sculk sensor will still activate it. This is not a vibration but a block interaction. The sculk sensor will __NOT__ however share that the entity caused the vibration. |

## Fields

---

## Examples
```json
{
    "type": "proviorigins:occlude_vibrations"
}
```
